svg.text: tt_um_singulardroid_davis - Tiny Tapeout GF180 analog tile (1x2): 2x2 DAVIS pixels + emulator + bias + monitor
ua[0] IPH emulator reference current, 1-100 uA into the pin (10 uA -> 20 nA per pixel)
ua[1] AMON buffered monitor output (amux16 -> obuf)
ua[2] IBIAS master bias current, 1 uA into the pin
ua[3] VON ON threshold voltage (~2.5 V), trim per chip
ua[4] VOFF OFF threshold voltage (~2.25 V), trim per chip
ua[5] VPR photoreceptor bias voltage (~2.7 V)
ui_in[0] RST diff-amp reset, all pixels (active high)
ui_in[1] RST_B APS reset (active low; hold low = DVS only)
ui_in[2] TX_B APS global shutter (active low)
ui_in[3] SEL APS row select -> each pixel drives its own COL
ui_in[5] STEP +50 % emulator step on all 4 pixels
ui_in[6] S0 monitor node select bit 0
ui_in[7] S1 monitor node select bit 1
uio_in[0] S2 monitor pixel select bit 0
uio_in[1] S3 monitor pixel select bit 1
uo_out[0..7] ON0 OFF0 ... ON3 OFF3 event outputs of pixels 0-3
Unused: uio_in[7:2], ena, clk, rst_n (no connect); uio_out / uio_oe tied low (tielo); ua[7:6] not usable on TT.
